title: Polymer/iron-oxide nanocomposite adsorbents for cycled magnetically-enabled extraction of aqueous micropollutants
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00701A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Eoin P. M c Kiernan, Alexa Ennis, Colm Delaney, Larisa Florea, Dermot F. Brougham
We present a facile, low-cost method for the preparation of milli-scale magnetic polymer prints which can be utilized as adsorbents for removal of methylene blue (MB) from aqueous solution.
